name: Skill request

title: "[Skill request] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Gap

What problem for AI coding agents in low-level programming is not covered? Be concrete:
name the failure class and, ideally, point to evidence (an incident, benchmark, or survey).

## Existing coverage

Check `docs/SKILLS.md` and `registry/cross-links.yaml` first. Which existing skill overlaps?
Per repository rules, a new skill must be differentiated (>30% unique) from existing ones.

## Primary sources

List the primary sources you would ground the skill in (standards, datasheets, CVEs,
papers). Every normative claim must trace to a primary source.

## Verification plan

How would this skill be verified? (toolchain, example strategy, eval categories)
